scenario: LGRA.13.11: an `emit` gives every non-nullable slot of the schema a value, except `ts`, which takes the instant of assertion; the compiler must reject one that omits one (DS_VALIDATE_MISSING_SLOT), naming the slot. A nullable slot omitted takes `null`. Pin: `emit Out` giving `n` and omitting `m` (non-nullable), while omitting the nullable `note` and `ts` as allowed. Path: the validator's emit check walks the schema's slots against the kwargs given.
rules_ds:
schema In scope logical:
    a: Int key

schema Out scope logical:
    n: Int key
    m: Int mutable
    note: String? mutable
    ts: Time

rule r:
    In i
->
    emit Out logical n: i.a
